user.title: Create a Bohu device
user.description: Create one device and upload URL. No device ID is needed: the first valid report binds it automatically.

data_description.base_url: Automatically filled from Home Assistant settings: local URL first, then external URL. Keep it if reachable by the sensor, or change it to the host LAN address and published port.

finish.title: Copy the upload URL
finish.description:
Your device's upload URL:

```text
{url}
```

**Submit to activate this URL**, then paste it into the sensor's custom upload address. Find it again under the integration's Configure button. Keep this URL private.

error.invalid_url: Enter an HTTP(S) address with host and optional port, without a path, credentials, query or fragment.
error.invalid_name: Enter a device name of 1–100 characters.

init.title: Upload URL and settings

data_description.gas_unit: Defaults to mg/m³, confirmed on the BH6 display for HCHO, TVOC and C6H6. Change only to match your device. Values are not converted.
data_description.timeout: 10–86400 seconds. Choose longer than the device's upload interval. Invalid reports do not reset this timer.

finish.title: Copy the upload URL
finish.description:
Upload URL:

```text
{url}
```

Submit to save. If the address changed, update the sensor too. Measurements wait for the next valid report after settings reload.
